LENGTH-VS-ROUTE CONTRADICTION, 6.4x -- WEAKER GEOMETRY, WEAKER EVIDENCE, SAME DIRECTIONAL VERDICT: the route trace is more likely wrong than the sheet's 19.12 km LengthKnown, but confidence is lower than P5862's finding -- flag to MZ as a lower-priority companion, do NOT redraw here and do NOT propose a LengthKnown change. EVIDENCE: (1) Same DRC-plan Table 5 (jx_plan.txt line 682) has a candidate entry, transcribed verbatim: '湖口一金剖，、湾一彭泽        23     口安一吉水              18.2' -- read as 湖口-金沙湾 (Hukou-Jinshawan), 23 km [the row's right-hand entry 口安一吉水/18.2 is a different, unrelated project]. This is the MOST heavily OCR-corrupted entry cited in this batch (the end-point name is mangled across five characters/punctuation marks, '金剖，、湾', versus a clean 金沙湾) -- treat this reading as substantially less certain than P5862's Shibi-Fengxin entry. (2) Background web search this session (not retained as a citable URL) corroborates 金砂湾/金沙湾工业园 (Jinshawan Industrial Park) as a real place in Hukou County with its own gas-supply history (九江湖口深燃天然气有限公司, est. ~2010, 30-year Hukou piped-gas franchise) -- supports the ENDPOINT's reality, not a length figure. (3) Same magnitude argument as P5862: 19.12 km (sheet) and 23 km (Table 5) both describe a short branch consistent with a single-county Hukou-to-industrial-park hop, while 123.15 km is roughly the length of the entire Phase II as-built network (98 km per the DRC plan) and structurally implausible for one named 'Branch.' VERIFICATION: url_verifier's automated substring screen FAILs on this 8.16MB/24-page CJK-text PDF for Chinese-language substrings (re-confirmed this session: FAIL on '金沙湾', OK on a bare numeral '870' -- the documented large-PDF/CJK-extraction false-negative family, same as shared_evidence.json and batch_01). Manually confirmed via pdftotext -layout on the locally-held extraction (jx_plan.txt), independently cross-checked this session against a fresh WebFetch re-download of the same URL: md5 identical (a396427a29f5ba9f852b2399f18e0e47) confirming the OCR corruption is inherent to the original scanned source (Producer: Adobe Acrobat 9.0 Paper Capture Plug-in, Creator: FUJITSU fi-6770dj scanner) and not a fetch/truncation artifact. Same source document/URL as the P5862 finding; the specific quoted line is at jx_plan.txt line 682. CAVEATS (why this is tier presumed, lower confidence than P5862): this row's RouteAccuracy is already 'very low (straight line/schematic)' per the task brief (i.e. GEM's own drawn geometry was never intended as precise here, unlike P5862's 'medium'), so the 123.15 km trace itself carries less evidentiary weight either way; the Table 5 end-point name match required inferring through five characters of OCR garbage rather than one; and 23 km vs 19.12 km is a larger relative gap (~20%) than P5862's 16 vs 18.45 (~11%). Net effect: this finding leans the same direction as P5862 (short length correct, long geometry wrong) but should be read as a weaker, secondary confirmation of the pattern rather than an independently strong result on its own.
